limits: These independently reproduced host defects are not proven to cause the observed kernel GPU fence wait; no native recovery claim.
A Vulkan timeout is not completion, and its requested duration cannot guarantee a driver returns promptly. Kernel D-state cannot be repaired by an application-level retry policy.
No title/shader/vendor switches or readback-setting changes. Previous eligible-image layout/alias limitations remain.
